name: 原始 TLS/Rust 客户端有界浮动定时轮换
summary: 单一 Linux 原始 Go 路径 supervisor 上可配置定时轮换±jitter；Game2/4整组真实认证代际替换而非逐 lane 独立热换，记录每一 lane 的全组新五元组和 native M4 身份。

usage.cli: Linux client --rotation-interval 18s --rotation-jitter 3s; jitter must be <= interval/3, min armed delay >=5s; server rejects positive interval
usage.config: Original Go CLI client cold supervisor only; no on-wire field

verification.platform: native Linux x86_64 original Go TLS client + x86_64 original Go TLS server
verification.scope: H1230 7/7 original Go TLS/Rust M4 native seven-mode 18s±3s four real grouped rotations per scene, 16219/16220 no-retry UDP, Game4 each of 4 TLS/port lanes ×5 generations independently matched within WHOLE group; independent lane-only hot-swap NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_RUN.

limitations: Group-scope: Game4 still one authenticated 4-lane Rust GameAdapter+shared FEC dedup and one complete 4-lane replacement generation. Each lane individually has new TLS/port each group generation, but independent lane1→2→3→4 rolling hot reauth while other three remain untouched NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_RUN; cannot infer from grouped PASS.
No zero-loss promise on actual WAN: test has no physical impairment; high-loss/Windows/Android not qualified.
H998 hot same-socket MTU FAIL and historical ARM Game4 FAIL retained. H1225 ARM p99 prior source does not certify H1226 source.
H1230 one actual real Game2 Off UDP missing reply in 16220 total packets across seven scenes; injected physical netem loss 0%. 99.9938% application receipts is not 100% packet reliability.
main_development_reason: 2026-11-05 用户明确在已授权PLAN028 M0 main单写者上要求增加浮动定时换代与多原生工况验证；只复用原始Go监督者和共享Rust M4，不另开传输/协议分支。
